evals.prompt: I have a Browserbase context ID and want to use its GitHub login in a local Chrome window. Move only github.com and its subdomains.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the skill to create a dedicated local Chrome profile and transfers only GitHub state.
assertions: The agent requests the context ID if it was not supplied
The command uses --domains github.com and a GitHub URL
The agent does not target the user's normal Chrome profile
The agent checks the resulting page for an authenticated state

evals.prompt: Copy my entire Browserbase context into my regular Chrome profile so I can browse locally.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that the script uses a separate local profile and that only browser state visible to Playwright is transferred; it does not overwrite the regular profile.
assertions: The agent does not point --profile at the normal Chrome data directory
The agent states that the transfer cannot reproduce the full Browserbase context
The agent offers a dedicated local Chrome profile

evals.prompt: Can I hand a Browserbase browser to a coworker so they can finish a login challenge?
evals.expected_output: The agent routes to a Browserbase Live View because no local state transfer is needed.
assertions: The agent does not export cookies unnecessarily
The agent explains that Live View lets a person control the cloud browser
